title: Inspect independent components
description: You follow the component update and inspect approximate feature directions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You center X and use singular value decomposition to project and scale it. A second decomposition turns the initial random W into U2 @ V2.
You update W using tanh-transformed projections and apply decorrelate again. The convergence check compares the new and previous directions through absolute diagonal values.
You request five components and plot up to the supplied number of initial samples. Adding 3*i offsets each plotted component vertically.

steps.question: Does the feature ranking use signed weights or their magnitudes?
steps.answer: It sorts absolute weights in descending order and keeps six features. The printed values retain their signs.

steps.description: You inspect the directions labeled approximate by the print heading. The recorded IC1 list starts with flavanoids at -0.423, while IC2 starts with color_intensity at +0.530.
